title: Morphing-BOT: Revolutionizing Global Infrastructure with AI-Powered Smart Inspection and Predictive Maintenance
summary: Morphing I reports that municipal pilots inspected more than 30 km of pipelines and produced validated inspection data. Avoided leaks and failures remain unmeasured.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Morphing I reports that municipal pilots inspected more than 30 km of pipelines and produced validated inspection data. The system is in early commercialization. Avoided leaks and failures remain unmeasured. The account provides no independent verification of the reported gains.
purpose: Inspect inaccessible water pipelines and support predictive maintenance.
deployer: Municipal pilot partners in Jeju, Jindo, Jeonju, and Siheung
location: Jeju, Jindo, Jeonju, and Siheung, South Korea

ratings.reason: Municipal pilots reportedly inspected more than 30 km and generated independently validated inspection data. Avoided pipeline failures remain unestablished.
More reliable water service and fewer leaks are intended; public resource and safety effects are unmeasured.

ai_role.statement: The account does not separately assess AI’s contribution to the benefit.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 1: Morphing-BOT: Revolutionizing Global Infrastructure with AI-Powered Smart Inspection and Predictive Maintenance

produced_by: The account does not separately establish the conditions responsible for the benefit.
must_hold: Multimodal sensors suitable for pipeline conditions
On-device processing where wireless communication is limited

headline: Morphing-BOT inspects water pipelines
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
